title.zh: 【Fibre 升级已上线 Celestia 主网，支持将 Blob 数据直接传输至验证者】
title.en: 【Fibre 升级已上线 Celestia 主网，支持将 Blob 数据直接传输至验证者】

current_state.zh: Celestia has activated its Fibre upgrade on mainnet, introducing the ZODA data-encoding scheme and direct blob delivery to validators to raise data availability throughput roughly 15x to about 150 MB/s.
current_state.en: Celestia has activated its Fibre upgrade on mainnet, introducing the ZODA data-encoding scheme and direct blob delivery to validators to raise data availability throughput roughly 15x to about 150 MB/s.
